title: Commission Tier/Flat — Reset Dates months offer only a blank and 1 (NM-3510 regression)
requirementSource: NM-3510 / NM-2168: each month offers a blank (0) and every day of that month
stepsToReproduce: Open Setup → Commissions → Tier/Flat for office 1101 (/navigator/locations/1101/commissions/tiers) on e2e and click Search.
Open the January selector, then February.
actualBehavior: Every month lists only a blank and "1".
